text:
Izzy (Design): just uploaded a new row-oriented mock for prompt-sets/evals with a tiny diff-bar on the left to show direction + magnitude. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/newmock/diffbar-row?node-id=0:1
Izzy (Design): try to keep rows compact for power reviewers; clicking a row expands inline. quick callouts: diff-bar should not rely on color only.
Marco (PM): looks promising. can we make bulk actions sticky and show selected count? also rename 'regressed' label — sounds scary.
Izzy (Design): thinking "quality change" or "degraded quality" depending on tone. bulk toolbar sticky with count + "Accept selected runs" and "Reject selected runs".
Jun (Frontend): perf note: virtualized list + dynamic heights. prefer a single <button> summary per row and separate icon buttons for actions to avoid event conflicts. will implement resize observer.
Rhea (A11y): accessibility: make diff-bar have textual tooltip + aria-label like "quality decreased by 4%". ensure row summary uses role="button" with aria-expanded. contrast check: current amber chip fails at small text.
Liam (UX Research): in rapid review tests users liked inline accept + undo toast. recommend a small inline confirm on first tap for touch to prevent fat-finger accepts.
Jun (Frontend): CI outputs: 
```
axe: color-contrast (SeverityChip) - 2.0:1 against white
eslint: jsx-a11y/no-noninteractive-element-interactions in RowSummary
```
Rhea (A11y): swap chip color to darker shade and change RowSummary wrapper to a button element. also make toast role="status" and ensure Undo is keyboard-focusable.
Izzy (Design): will update figma to include chevron + percentage text on the diff-bar and softer copy: "quality change". adding filter chips (High/Med/Low) in the toolbar.
Marco (PM): add audit log event for accept/reject actions. also include undo affordance in the spec text.
Jun (Frontend): will fix the a11y issues, add keyboard nav (Enter expands, Space toggles selection), and post a short demo video in the PR.
ci-bot: note: please add an axe baseline for /prompt-sets and /evals routes to prevent regressions.
Izzy (Design): thanks everyone, pushing updated frames in an hour. leaving thread open for any last-minute copy/a11y tweaks. :sparkles:
